title: Buick OBD/OBD2 Codes >> Century 2.2L • Century 3.1 L • LeSabre 3.8L • Park Avenue 3.8L Rainier 4.2/5.3L • Regal 3.1L • Regal 3.8L • Rendezvous 3.4/3.5L

procedures.heading: General information
steps: Malfunction indicator lamp (MIL) will illuminate or flash if certain faults are recorded.
ECM operates in backup mode if sensors fail, to enable vehicle to be driven to repair shop.

procedures.heading: Accessing
steps: Trouble codes can only be displayed by using a Scan Tool connected to the data link connector (DLC).

procedures.heading: Erasing
steps: Ensure ignition switched OFF for at least 10 seconds.
Disconnect battery ground cable for at least 30 seconds.
Repeat accessing procedure to ensure no trouble codes remain in ECM fault memory.

procedures.heading: Erasing
steps: After the faults have been rectified, the manufacturer recommends that trouble codes are erased by using a Scan Tool connected to the data link connector (DLC).

Turning the engine OFF while driving.
Pressing the accelerator pedal to start the engine.
